name: Advanced Spam Protection for Contact Form 7
author: TechArk Solutions

sections.description:
Are you tired of receiving spam through Contact Form 7?
Bots, fake leads, and automated scripts constantly target CF7 forms — even if you use reCAPTCHA or honey pots.

Advanced Spam Protection for Contact Form 7 provides a complete, modern, and intelligent way to stop Contact Form 7 spam, without annoying users or adding CAPTCHA.

This plugin uses multiple advanced layers of protection:

  • Timing-based spam detection
  • Repeated submission blocking
  • VPN / Proxy detection
  • Multi-IP usage analysis
  • Browser fingerprint tracking
  • Behavior-based heuristics
  • Submission logging with detailed data
  • SweetAlert UI for clean error messages

The plugin works immediately after activation — no form editing required.

Features

  • Automatic protection — works instantly with all Contact Form 7 forms.
  • Configurable minimum submission time.
  • Repeated submission blocker.
  • VPN / Proxy detection.
  • Browser fingerprinting.
  • Behavior-based heuristics.
  • Detailed logs (IP, fingerprint, spam reason, user agent).
  • Lightweight — no external API required.
  • Clean SweetAlert UI alerts.

Plugin Settings

Located under Tools → CF7 Spam Shield.

Minimum Submission Time

Detects instant bot submissions.
Recommended: 3–5 seconds.

Block Repeated Submissions

Prevents multiple attempts from the same user/bot.

VPN / Proxy Check

Detects suspicious IP ranges.

Browser Fingerprint Tracking

Identifies bots even if IP changes.

Log Viewer

View blocked and passed submissions with detailed info.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin to /wp-content/plugins/
  2. Activate through Plugins → Installed Plugins
  3. Protection starts automatically
  4. Go to Tools → CF7 Spam Shield to configure
  5. View logs at Tools → CF7 Spam Logs
sections.faq:
Do I need to modify my Contact Form 7 forms?

No. Everything works automatically.

Does the plugin store sensitive data?

Only essential spam detection data.

Will it slow down my site?

No. The plugin is lightweight and optimized.

Does it work with reCAPTCHA?

Yes, it works alongside reCAPTCHA.
